log: Evidence for N26: 42 meshes, 7 materials (default_2, Material_12..Material_17), no uv, no texture, no colours, so colour could not be a basis. Single-island meshes always report at 0.50 (relative to themselves), so position only appears for multi-island meshes.

Names are generated by rule from size alone: <size band>_<shape>_<odd axis>_<Finish>_<position words>. Size band = quintile of an island max extent among all parts of this model. Shape from the sorted extents: Equal_Sided_Lump (all within 8%), Plate/Stubby_Block/Bar (two equal extents, third thinner than half / between / more than double; Axis is the odd extent), Slab, Long_Box, Box_Body. Equal extents may be round or square; the report cannot say, so no function word (disc, shaft, roller, ...) is used.
Finish_<Greek> = material, ranked alphabetically by name (uppercase sorts first, so Material_12 gets Alpha and default_2 gets the last Greek word). Only a stand-in label for distinct materials.

Several meshes under different materials hold the same geometry (e.g. meshes 3 and 14, 25/27/36, 28/37, 30/39, 33/41, 22/35): same triangle counts and sizes under default_2 and Material_13. The finish tag keeps their names distinct; the evidence does not say which is an alternate/duplicate of which.

Mesh 10 has 68 islands (many identical 0.36 cubes arranged in rings at low and high z, plus a few 0.55-thick plates of larger extent) and mesh 1 has 18 identical islands; each is a separate part named by position words from at (mesh frame). Position words collide for some mirrored islands, so a Peer_<letters> suffix (meaningless) disambiguates.
Doubt: no part has enough evidence for a functional name; group and part names are shape-descriptive on purpose (abstention).
Finish map: Finish_Alpha=Material_12, Finish_Beta=Material_13, Finish_Gamma=Material_14, Finish_Delta=Material_15, Finish_Epsilon=Material_16, Finish_Zeta=Material_17, Finish_Eta=default_2
